trackers.monetization_model: The Pure SDK sends location data to Unacast's cloud so that users can be targeted in other contexts (the SDK's documentation, last published November 2019). Unacast, now Gravy Analytics trading as Unacast, sells location-based data services to customers including advertisers, law enforcement and national security agencies, and says it may sell sensitive personal data (its privacy policy); its subsidiary Venntel sells location data to public sector customers (FTC).
sold_to: law enforcement and national security customers

consequences.text: In 2025 the US FTC barred Gravy Analytics and its subsidiary Venntel from selling, disclosing or using sensitive location data. There are limited exceptions for national security and law enforcement. Gravy Analytics now trades as Unacast. The FTC charged that they sold location data, including visits to health-related places and places of worship, without verifying people's consent.
consequences.wording: Settled with the US FTC (2025); Gravy Analytics and Venntel neither admitted nor denied the charges.
